answer: Chained answer lineage with parent hashing: each accepted answer must embed the hash of the identity's previous accepted answer, so every account's work forms one unbroken chain the ledger can verify. A forked or recycled text breaks the chain and forfeits that epoch's emission. A sybil farm must grow a separate jade chain of genuine answers for every puppet - no cloning, since two keys citing one parent or repeating timber-stiff boilerplate collide visibly. Cross-copying leaves yarrow-thin threads between chains, and the auditor prunes every linked cluster at once.
